name: Ajrasakha-Hackathon
description: Ajrasakha Hackathon project with consumer-portal and server

scripts.install:prediction: cd pridiction-engine && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.setup:env: test -f .env || (cp .env.example .env 2>/dev/null && echo 'Created .env from .env.example - PLEASE CONFIGURE VALUES') || echo 'WARNING: .env.example not found. Create .env manually with required values.'
scripts.install:all: bun run setup:env && bun run install:shared && bun run install:consumer-portal && bun run install:server && bun run install:seeder && bun run install:loader && bun run install:parser && bun run install:prediction
scripts.dev: concurrently "bun run dev:consumer-portal" "bun run dev:server" "bun run dev:prediction" "bun run dev:apmc-portal" "bun run dev:dev-portal"
scripts.build: bun run build:consumer-portal && bun run build:server
scripts.prod: bun run build && bun run start:server
